name: claude-fleet
description: Personal marketplace: tooling for running parallel coding agents as a managed fleet.

plugins.name: agent-fleet
plugins.description: Run parallel feature work as a fleet of Herdr agents: one git worktree per feature, one Claude agent per worktree, and a manager that reviews, sequences merges and files issues. Ships the manager CLI, a pre-merge review agent, and a PreToolUse guard that makes the manager structurally unable to edit feature code.
